title: Former Rugby League Player Brian Smith Dies at 59
summary: Brian Smith, a former player for the Wallabies and in rugby league, has died at the age of 59. He passed away after a battle with cancer. Smith also coached the England national team.
summary_points: Brian Smith, former Wallabies and rugby league player, has died.
Smith died after a battle with cancer.
He also served as a former coach for the England national team.
